description: Benchmark questions for the built-in sample sales dataset (seed=42, generated by backend/app/data/sample_data.py). Expected values were computed directly with pandas against the same seed, independent of the agent pipeline, so they are ground truth rather than 'whatever the model said last time'. tolerance_pct is the allowed relative error for numeric answers.
